result: This is where the familiar talk of widening your "window of tolerance" becomes practical: titration, pendulation, and orientation each ask the same question, which is whether you can touch something difficult in a small enough dose, notice what happens, and return. Building these capacities may take some people three to six months of focused effort, and severe developmental trauma can take longer, but I would treat that range as a rough guide rather than a countdown. If you are stable and have one clear target, you may be ready for focused trauma work much sooner.
